blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解滲透壓 (osmotic pressure) 的生物學意義，及其在無菌注射劑開發中的核心地位
blocks.en: Understand the biological significance of osmotic pressure and its central role in sterile injectable development

blocks.zh: 區分並正確使用 osmolality（滲透量）、osmolarity（滲透濃度）與 tonicity（張力）三個術語
blocks.en: Distinguish and correctly use the three terms osmolality, osmolarity and tonicity

blocks.zh: 掌握凍結點下降 (freezing-point depression)、蒸氣壓下降 (vapor pressure depression) 等依數性質的數學基礎
blocks.en: Grasp the mathematical basis of colligative properties such as freezing-point depression and vapor pressure depression

blocks.zh: 了解 Pitzer–Debye–Hückel 方程如何用於推算 NaCl 校正液的標準濃度
blocks.en: Understand how the Pitzer–Debye–Hückel equation is used to derive the standard concentrations of NaCl calibration solutions

blocks.zh: 認識滲透量測量在製藥品管與患者安全上的直接關聯
blocks.en: Recognize the direct link between osmolality measurement, pharmaceutical quality control and patient safety

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Osmolality (滲透量)：直接測量值，單位為 mOsmol/kg（溶質莫耳數 ÷ 溶劑公斤數）。這是實驗室實際量到的數字。
blocks.en: Osmolality: a directly measured value, expressed in mOsmol/kg (moles of solute ÷ kilograms of solvent). This is the number the laboratory actually measures.

blocks.zh: Osmolarity (滲透濃度)：計算值，單位為 mOsmol/L（溶質莫耳數 ÷ 溶液公升數）。臨床常用，但必須由 osmolality 換算而來。
blocks.en: Osmolarity: a calculated value, expressed in mOsmol/L (moles of solute ÷ liters of solution). It is commonly used clinically, but it must be derived from osmolality.

blocks.zh: Tonicity (張力)：醫學術語，描述溶液對細胞膜造成的淨滲透壓差。並非所有 osmolality 貢獻都能影響 tonicity（例如尿素可自由穿越細胞膜，對 tonicity 無貢獻）。
blocks.en: Tonicity: a medical term describing the net osmotic pressure difference a solution exerts across a cell membrane. Not every contribution to osmolality affects tonicity (for example, urea crosses the cell membrane freely and does not contribute to tonicity).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把細胞膜想像成一扇只讓水分子通過、但擋住鹽分子的半透膜。當細胞外液太鹹（高滲），水會從細胞內流出，細胞就像葡萄乾一樣萎縮；若外液太淡（低滲），水則湧入細胞直到細胞脹破。這就是為何靜脈注射劑的滲透量必須嚴格管控。
blocks.en: Picture the cell membrane as a semipermeable barrier that lets water molecules through but blocks salt. When the extracellular fluid is too salty (hypertonic), water flows out of the cell and the cell shrivels like a raisin; if the extracellular fluid is too dilute (hypotonic), water rushes in until the cell bursts. This is why the osmolality of intravenous injections must be tightly controlled.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 三個術語「不可互換使用」是 USP 的明確警示。在 CMC 文件、標籤及檢驗報告中，必須清楚標明使用的是 osmolality（測量值）還是 osmolarity（計算值）。混用術語可能導致臨床劑量計算錯誤。
blocks.en: That the three terms are "not interchangeable" is an explicit USP warning. In CMC documents, labels and test reports, it must be clear whether osmolality (a measured value) or osmolarity (a calculated value) is being used. Mixing the terms can lead to errors in clinical dose calculations.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼滲透壓是「依數性質 (colligative property)」？這意味著什麼物理現象？
blocks.en: Why is osmotic pressure a "colligative property"? What physical phenomenon does this imply?

blocks.zh: 一個滲透量高的溶液打入靜脈，對紅血球會有什麼影響？請用生理學解釋。
blocks.en: What happens to red blood cells when a solution of high osmolality is injected intravenously? Explain in physiological terms.

blocks.zh: Tonicity 和 osmolality 的關鍵差異是什麼？舉一個溶質的例子說明兩者可能不一致的情況。
blocks.en: What is the key difference between tonicity and osmolality? Give an example of a solute for which the two may not agree.

blocks.zh: Theoretical Background 理論背景
blocks.en: Theoretical Background

blocks.zh: Water activity (水活度) aw：描述溶液中水分子「有效可用程度」的無量綱值。純水的 aw = 1；加入溶質後 aw 下降，導致水從高 aw 端流向低 aw 端（即從低溶質端流向高溶質端）。
blocks.en: Water activity aw: a dimensionless value describing how "effectively available" the water molecules in a solution are. For pure water aw = 1; adding solute lowers aw, so water moves from the high-aw side to the low-aw side (that is, from the low-solute side to the high-solute side).

blocks.zh: Osmolality coefficient Φm（滲透量係數）：真實溶液的修正因子。理想溶液 Φm = 1；實際溶液（尤其是電解質）Φm ≠ 1，需要實驗測定。NaCl 在生理濃度下 Φm ≈ 0.93。
blocks.en: Osmolality coefficient Φm: a correction factor for real solutions. For an ideal solution Φm = 1; for real solutions (especially electrolytes) Φm ≠ 1 and must be determined experimentally. For NaCl at physiological concentrations, Φm ≈ 0.93.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Key Formulas
blocks.en: Key Formulas

blocks.zh: 把 ν（解離係數）想像成一個家庭分家後的成員數。NaCl 這個「家庭」分成 Na⁺ 和 Cl⁻ 兩個成員，因此它對滲透量的貢獻是同樣濃度不解離溶質（如葡萄糖）的兩倍。這就解釋了為何 0.9% NaCl 的滲透量比同重量的葡萄糖溶液高得多。
blocks.en: Think of ν (the dissociation factor) as the number of members in a family after it splits up. The NaCl "family" separates into two members, Na⁺ and Cl⁻, so its contribution to osmolality is twice that of a non-dissociating solute (such as glucose) at the same concentration. This explains why 0.9% NaCl has a much higher osmolality than a glucose solution of the same weight concentration.

blocks.zh: 多溶質疊加法（additive approach）假設每種溶質的 Φ<sub>m</sub> 在混合物中與單獨存在時相同。這在低濃度下是合理近似，但在高濃度或有溶質-溶質相互作用時可能產生誤差。USP 明確提示此為簡化方法。
blocks.en: The additive approach for multiple solutes assumes that the Φ<sub>m</sub> of each solute in the mixture is the same as when it is present alone. This is a reasonable approximation at low concentrations, but it can introduce errors at high concentrations or when solute-solute interactions are present. USP explicitly notes that this is a simplified method.

blocks.zh: 若一種藥物在溶液中部分解離（ν = 1.5），理論上如何計算其 osmolality 貢獻？
blocks.en: If a drug is partially dissociated in solution (ν = 1.5), how would you theoretically calculate its contribution to osmolality?

blocks.zh: 為何要引入 Φ<sub>m</sub>（滲透量係數）？它反映了溶液的什麼物理性質？
blocks.en: Why is Φ<sub>m</sub> (the osmolality coefficient) introduced? What physical property of the solution does it reflect?

blocks.zh: Freezing-Point Depression & Vapor Pressure Methods 凍結點下降與蒸氣壓法
blocks.en: Freezing-Point Depression & Vapor Pressure Methods

blocks.zh: Freezing-point depression (凍結點下降)：溶液凍結點低於純水（0°C），下降幅度正比於滲透量。是最常用的 osmolality 測量原理。每 1 mOsmol/kg ≈ 1.86 × 10⁻³ °C 的凍結點下降。
blocks.en: Freezing-point depression: the freezing point of a solution is lower than that of pure water (0°C), and the depression is proportional to osmolality. This is the most widely used principle for measuring osmolality. Each 1 mOsmol/kg corresponds to a freezing-point depression of about 1.86 × 10⁻³ °C.

blocks.zh: Vapor pressure osmometry（蒸氣壓滲透量測定）：利用露點 (dew point) 下降原理，在室溫下測量。測量值代表環境溫度下的 osmolality，與凍結點法（在凍結點測量）結果可能不同——因為某些溶質的解離程度隨溫度改變。
blocks.en: Vapor pressure osmometry: uses the principle of dew point depression and is measured at room temperature. The result represents osmolality at ambient temperature and may differ from the freezing-point method (measured at the freezing point), because the degree of dissociation of some solutes changes with temperature.

blocks.zh: 公式速查 Formula Reference
blocks.en: Formula Reference

blocks.zh:
凍結點下降法 (Freezing-Point):
  ΔTf = Kf × ξm
  Kf (water) = 1.86056 K·kg/mol
  例：290 mOsmol/kg → ΔTf = 1.86056 × 0.290
                            = 0.5396°C 下降

蒸氣壓法 (Vapor Pressure, at 25°C):
  ΔTD = KD × ξm
  KD (25°C) = 0.3027 K·kg/mol

兩法靈敏度比:
  Kf / KD = 1.86 / 0.30 ≈ 6.2×
  凍結點法靈敏度約為蒸氣壓法的6倍
blocks.en:
Freezing-Point Method:
  ΔTf = Kf × ξm
  Kf (water) = 1.86056 K·kg/mol
  Example: 290 mOsmol/kg → ΔTf = 1.86056 × 0.290
                            = 0.5396°C depression

Vapor Pressure Method (at 25°C):
  ΔTD = KD × ξm
  KD (25°C) = 0.3027 K·kg/mol

Sensitivity ratio of the two methods:
  Kf / KD = 1.86 / 0.30 ≈ 6.2×
  The freezing-point method is about 6 times as sensitive as the vapor pressure method

blocks.zh: 想像你在山頂（低氣壓）煮水，水的沸點比海平面低。依數性質的道理是一樣的——溶液中加入溶質，就像改變了水分子的「逃逸意願」：沸點升高（難以逃逸成蒸氣）、凍結點下降（難以結成冰晶）。這些微小的溫度變化就是滲透量計的量測原理。
blocks.en: Imagine boiling water at the top of a mountain (low air pressure): the boiling point is lower than at sea level. Colligative properties work on the same logic. Adding solute to water changes the "willingness to escape" of the water molecules: the boiling point rises (it is harder to escape as vapor) and the freezing point falls (it is harder to form ice crystals). These tiny temperature changes are exactly what an osmometer measures.

blocks.zh: 兩種方法對相同樣品可能給出不同結果。這不是錯誤，而是物理現象：凍結點法在 0°C 測量；蒸氣壓法在室溫（~25°C）測量。含揮發性成分（如乙醇）的樣品，蒸氣壓法會產生誤差，因為揮發性溶質會在測量過程中蒸發。此情況必須改用凍結點法。
blocks.en: The two methods can give different results for the same sample. This is not an error but a physical phenomenon: the freezing-point method measures at 0°C, while the vapor pressure method measures at room temperature (~25°C). For samples containing volatile components (such as ethanol), the vapor pressure method gives erroneous results because the volatile solute evaporates during measurement. In this case the freezing-point method must be used instead.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 製劑開發時，若產品含乙醇（如某些注射用溶媒）或其他揮發性輔料，必須選用凍結點滲透量計。如果誤用蒸氣壓法，乙醇在量測過程中揮發，會低估實際滲透量，導致產品被誤判為等滲而進入臨床。
blocks.en: In CDMO formulation development, if the product contains ethanol (as in some injectable solvents) or other volatile excipients, a freezing-point osmometer must be used. If the vapor pressure method is used by mistake, the ethanol evaporates during measurement and the true osmolality is underestimated, so a product may be wrongly judged isotonic and proceed to clinical use.

blocks.zh: 若測得某注射劑的凍結點為 -0.558°C（相對純水），其 osmolality 為多少 mOsmol/kg？
blocks.en: If the freezing point of an injection is measured as -0.558°C (relative to pure water), what is its osmolality in mOsmol/kg?

blocks.zh: 為何含有乙醇的樣品不能用蒸氣壓滲透量計測量？請從原理解釋。
blocks.en: Why can a sample containing ethanol not be measured with a vapor pressure osmometer? Explain from the principle.

blocks.zh: 凍結點法與蒸氣壓法哪個對低 osmolality 樣品更靈敏？為什麼？
blocks.en: Which is more sensitive for low-osmolality samples, the freezing-point method or the vapor pressure method? Why?

blocks.zh: Calibration Standards — NaCl Solutions 氯化鈉校正標準液
blocks.en: Calibration Standards — NaCl Solutions

blocks.zh: Pitzer–Debye–Hückel 方程：這是電解質溶液非理想行為的最佳半理論模型，結合了長程靜電作用（Debye–Hückel 項）與短程離子-離子相互作用（virial 展開項）。對於滲透量校正液的精確配製至關重要。
blocks.en: Pitzer–Debye–Hückel equation: this is the best semi-theoretical model of the non-ideal behavior of electrolyte solutions, combining long-range electrostatic interactions (the Debye–Hückel term) with short-range ion-ion interactions (the virial expansion terms). It is essential for the accurate preparation of osmolality calibration solutions.

blocks.zh: 為什麼用 NaCl？NaCl 是生物體液的主要電解質、溶解度高、純度可精確控制、與人體滲透量範圍完美匹配（生理值約 285–310 mOsmol/kg），且其 Φm-molality 關係已有大量實驗數據。
blocks.en: Why NaCl? NaCl is the main electrolyte of biological fluids, is highly soluble, can be obtained at precisely controlled purity, matches the human osmolality range well (physiological values of about 285–310 mOsmol/kg), and has a large body of experimental data on its Φm-molality relationship.

blocks.zh: 校正用 NaCl 溶液就像音叉之於調音師——它的滲透量已由第一原理推算並經實驗驗證，可信度高。USP Table 1 所列的配方精度（±1 mOsmol/kg）遠高於市售校正液（±2 mOsmol/kg 或 ±0.5%），自配時必須嚴格遵守秤量精度要求。
blocks.en: A NaCl calibration solution is to an osmometer what a tuning fork is to a piano tuner: its osmolality has been derived from first principles and verified experimentally, so it is highly reliable. The formulation accuracy given in USP Table 1 (±1 mOsmol/kg) is far better than that of commercial calibration solutions (±2 mOsmol/kg or ±0.5%), so the weighing accuracy requirements must be strictly followed when preparing in-house.

blocks.zh: NaCl 必須預先在 110°C 乾燥 2 小時，去除吸附水分
blocks.en: NaCl must be pre-dried at 110°C for 2 hours to remove adsorbed moisture

blocks.zh: 稱量精度：NaCl ±0.03 g；水 ±0.2 g——這不是建議，是保證 ±1 mOsmol/kg 精度的必要條件
blocks.en: Weighing accuracy: NaCl ±0.03 g; water ±0.2 g. This is not a recommendation but a necessary condition for guaranteeing ±1 mOsmol/kg accuracy

blocks.zh: 儲存在玻璃容器（非透氣容器），防止水分蒸發改變濃度
blocks.en: Store in glass containers (not gas-permeable containers) to prevent evaporation from changing the concentration

blocks.zh: 非無菌非防腐劑溶液，每月至少新鮮配製一次
blocks.en: Non-sterile, preservative-free solutions; prepare fresh at least once a month

blocks.zh: 市售安瓿裝校正液：一次性使用，開封後丟棄
blocks.en: Commercial ampouled calibration solutions: single use; discard after opening

blocks.zh: 實驗室計算示例
blocks.en: Laboratory Calculation Example

blocks.zh:
配製 290 mOsmol/kg 標準液（模擬血漿滲透量）：
  Table 1 → 9.165 g NaCl per kg H₂O

  步驟：
  1. 稱取 NaCl（已於 110°C 乾燥2h）= 9.165 ± 0.03 g
  2. 稱取純水（Milli-Q 或同等級）= 1000.0 ± 0.2 g
  3. 溶解混勻
  4. 儲存於玻璃容器，標記製備日期

  精度保證：±1 mOsmol/kg
  有效期：每月更新
blocks.en:
Preparing a 290 mOsmol/kg standard (simulating plasma osmolality):
  Table 1 → 9.165 g NaCl per kg H₂O

  Steps:
  1. Weigh NaCl (dried at 110°C for 2 h) = 9.165 ± 0.03 g
  2. Weigh purified water (Milli-Q or equivalent grade) = 1000.0 ± 0.2 g
  3. Dissolve and mix
  4. Store in a glass container and label with the preparation date

  Guaranteed accuracy: ±1 mOsmol/kg
  Shelf life: renew monthly

blocks.zh: 為何必須使用「乾燥後」的 NaCl 配製標準液？若未乾燥，對結果有何影響？
blocks.en: Why must "dried" NaCl be used to prepare the standard solution? What effect would undried NaCl have on the result?

blocks.zh: 市售校正安瓿與自配 NaCl 標準液相比，各有何優缺點？在哪些情境下你會選擇各自哪種？
blocks.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of commercial calibration ampoules versus in-house NaCl standards? In which situations would you choose each?

blocks.zh: 若需要測量 1500 mOsmol/kg 的高濃度溶液，應選擇哪個 Table 1 標準液進行校正？
blocks.en: To measure a high-concentration solution of 1500 mOsmol/kg, which Table 1 standard should you select for calibration?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 滲透壓是依數性質，由溶質粒子的數量決定，不取決於種類——這是 osmolality 測量的根本原理
blocks.en: Osmotic pressure is a colligative property, determined by the number of solute particles and not by their type; this is the fundamental principle of osmolality measurement

blocks.zh: Osmolality（mOsmol/kg）是測量值；osmolarity（mOsmol/L）是計算值；tonicity 是醫學術語，三者不可混用
blocks.en: Osmolality (mOsmol/kg) is a measured value; osmolarity (mOsmol/L) is a calculated value; tonicity is a medical term; the three must not be used interchangeably

blocks.zh: 凍結點下降法（K<sub>f</sub> = 1.86 K·kg/mol）是最靈敏、最常用的測量方法；蒸氣壓法在室溫運作，但不適用於含揮發性溶質的樣品
blocks.en: Freezing-point depression (K<sub>f</sub> = 1.86 K·kg/mol) is the most sensitive and most commonly used measurement method; the vapor pressure method operates at room temperature but is not suitable for samples containing volatile solutes

blocks.zh: 真實溶液需引入 osmolality coefficient（Φ<sub>m</sub>）修正；NaCl 的 Φ<sub>m</sub> 由 Pitzer–Debye–Hückel 方程精確推算，支撐 USP Table 1 校正液配方
blocks.en: Real solutions require correction with the osmolality coefficient (Φ<sub>m</sub>); the Φ<sub>m</sub> of NaCl is accurately derived from the Pitzer–Debye–Hückel equation, which underpins the USP Table 1 calibration solution formulations

blocks.zh: 校正標準液的配製精度（秤量、乾燥、儲存）直接決定滲透量測量的可追溯性，是品質體系的關鍵控制點
blocks.en: The preparation accuracy of calibration standards (weighing, drying, storage) directly determines the traceability of osmolality measurements and is a critical control point of the quality system
